outline:
本門課之目的是讓學生熟悉研究方法設計。主題涵蓋研究計劃之準備及撰擬 ;主要研究方法，如調查研究法、相關研究法、實驗研究法、個案研究法、人種誌研究法，行動研究法，觀察研究法；質性和量化資料之搜集與分析；敘述統計和推論統計。
This course familiarizes students with the procedures of research in applied linguistics. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; correlational research; case study; grounded theory research; ethnographic research; action research; data collection and data analysis; descriptive statistics; and basic knowledge concerning inferential statistics.
schedule:
Week                     Topic
1                     Orientation
2                     Qualitative, quantitative and mixed methods    research
3                     Quality criteria for research and other research issues (validity and reliability)
4                     Qualitative data collection
5                     Ethnography
6                     Observation
7                     Interviewing
8                     Case studies                   9                     grounded theory
10                    Classroom research; action research
11                    Qualitative data analysis
12                    Quantitative data collection (Computerized data analysis and SPSS)
13                    Experimental research and quasi-experimental research
14                    Survey research
15                    Survey research
16                    Quantitative data analysis              17                    Writing quantitative and qualitative research papers and proposals. (APA style manual)
18                    Final Exam
assessment:
Evaluation
Oral presentations: 30%
Journal writing:30%
Final term paper or reflective paper (observation, interviewing, or survey): 30%
Attendance and participation: 10%
